messages:
Dan - WidgetCo (Customer): We're seeing lots of missing spans in Trace View for checkout flows since yesterday. Request IDs are present in our app logs but they don't link to traces in the console. Counts look wrong in the dashboard.
Asha (Support): Sorry about that, Dan. Can you share one failing request-id and the approximate times? We'll escalate to eng if needed.
Dan - WidgetCo (Customer): request-id: 0a7f3d1c, timeframe around 2026-03-14T22:10Z - 22:15Z. I can reproduce locally where the UI shows "No spans found" but backend logs show the request-id.
Ethan (SRE): @Asha tagging in SRE. First pass: any ingestion errors or reindex jobs failing for WidgetCo tenant?
TraceIngestBot: reindex-job/tenant-widgetco started 2026-03-15T01:10Z -> FAILED (exit 1) | context: "kv-snapshot-not-found"
Priya (Eng): I can see that failure in the reindexer history. The job crashed while linking span edges due to a missing KV snapshot. Might have been GCed between snapshot list and read.
Asha (Support): Dan, can you run a quick repro curl with headers so eng can search raw ingest logs?
Dan - WidgetCo (Customer): Sure — header dump: {"x-request-id":"0a7f3d1c","user-agent":"widgetco/1.2"}. Hitting prod endpoint reproduces the missing-link behavior.
Priya (Eng): Doing a targeted DB lookup now:
```
SELECT * FROM spans WHERE request_id='0a7f3d1c' LIMIT 50;
```
Result: 0 rows returned. But raw ingest shows span batches for the same request id arrived and were acked.
Ethan (SRE): That implies the spans existed but the link table (span_edges / request_to_trace) didnt get populated. I'll try the repair tool for that request-id.
Priya (Eng): Quick check of the reindexer logs shows error stack: "kv-snapshot-not-found -> abort linking for batch". So the reindex job didn't retry and exited.
Ethan (SRE): Running repair:
/run repair-trace-links --tenant widgetco --request-id 0a7f3d1c
TraceIngestBot: repair-trace-links job queued (job-7734) for tenant widgetco, request-id 0a7f3d1c
TraceIngestBot: job-7734 completed: 12 edges restored for request-id 0a7f3d1c
Priya (Eng): Re-run SELECT now returns 12 span rows and the Trace View in console loads the full tree for that request.
Asha (Support): Dan, can you refresh your UI and confirm the trace is visible now? :crossed_fingers:
Dan - WidgetCo (Customer): Confirmed — full trace appears and counts match expected values. Thanks for the fast repair.
Priya (Eng): Root cause summary: reindexer hit a transient kv-snapshot-not-found and exited without retrying; this left some tenants with missing span-edge links. Action items: add retry/backoff in reindexer on kv-snapshot-not-found (ENG-2026), and schedule reindex jobs outside of KV rotation windows.
Ethan (SRE): Also adding an alert for reindex job failure rate > 0.5% per day and a dashboard showing recent repair job counts.
Asha (Support): I'll mark the support ticket for follow-up and re-open if Dan sees recurrence. Closing when we have ENG-2026 tracked. Thanks all! :tada:
